messages.speaker: me
messages.text: there's water coming through the ceiling light in the hall. not a drip, more than a drip

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: yeah saw it earlier. towel's down

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: is it still pooling

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: pooling a bit. something behind the toilet

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: calling the emergency line, they want photos of the ceiling and the floor

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: took two, sent them to your email

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: got them. he says shut the mains off

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: done. hall light's dead too now

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: that's the same circuit, normal when it's isolated. don't worry about it tonight

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: k. towels soaked, window's open

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: don't stay up over it. text me if it gets worse

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: stopped now. carpet's wet, ceiling's dry

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: good. plumber can only do friday morning, i'll keep chasing them

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: plumber confirmed friday 9am but wants someone home. can you do it or should we swap?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: i'll be in, i'm home anyway

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: amazing, i'll tell him. the kitchen tap started dripping too, think it's connected

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: maybe. i'll look at it tonight

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: no rush, it's a drip not a flood

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: k

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: did you end up looking at it

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: it's the washer. ordered one, comes weds

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: nice, five minute fix when it lands

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: i've done one before. kind of

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: i'll supervise from the sofa

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: that's the plan

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: reminder: plumber friday 9am, you're on door duty. also the washer landed

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: ok. ill put the kettle on

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: hero. bring coffee upstairs too, i'm on revision five of this deck

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: k

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: one more thing — he asked if the bathroom tiling is original, no idea on my end

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: all original i think. ask mum, she was there

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: true. i'll text her tonight

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: she says 1987

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: 1987, great. friday it is then

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: friday

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: i'll get milk and something for lunch

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: good pastries. not from the corner shop
